record.question:
In March 1869, the British dispatched a third expedition from Cachar in two columns to punish
    suspected Mizo chiefs. Who commanded these two columns?
options: Captain George Blackwood and Colonel Frederick Lister
Brigadier General G. Bourchier and Brigadier General C.H. Brownlow
Edward Baker and Brigadier General Nuthall
Colonel G.J. Skinner and W.W. Daly
